# MindLever Foundry
**Purpose**: Industry-agnostic agentic product discovery, governance, and functional-prototype delivery through the Foundry skills layer.
This Notion area is the operating home for the inverted Foundry process; GitHub versions the skills, source, tests, and governance markdown.
## Live Governance Artifacts
-
	<page url="https://app.notion.com/p/3b2792ca088881519d65c42e1b758d25">Foundry Governance Charter</page>
-
	<page url="https://app.notion.com/p/3b2792ca088881488e15df03248b69ac">Foundry Governance Playbook</page>
## Structure (Expanding)
- Governance (Team Charter + Governance Charter + Playbook) ✅ live
- Process artifacts from each cycle (White Space Maps, Verdict Cards, Craft Briefs, Prototypes)
- Requirements database ✅ live
- Architecture page ✅ live
- Decision Log ✅ live
- Roadmap ✅ live
- Backlog ✅ live
## Core Process (Locked)
`00-foundry` (Orchestrator) → `01-foundry-whitespace` → `02-foundry-concept` → `03-foundry-brief` → `04-foundry-craft`
**Key locked rules**:
- Appetite required and locked from Whitespace
- Future Customer Experience paragraph required on every GO
- Explicit kill criteria (no soft kills)
- UI/Accessibility hard constraint (WCAG 2.2 AA subset + selected Nielsen heuristics + ≤60s + one primary path)
**Influences**: PMI Agile Practice Guide + Basecamp Shape Up (Appetite, fixed time / variable scope).
Notion and GitHub each hold defined authoritative artifacts; every fact has one home and all work must be repeatable by a new team member.
**Product Owner**: Tait Goodwin  
Virtual Product Manager / Interim Governance: Morgan Lee
Virtual team: Alex Rivera (Engineering), Sam Patel (UX), Casey Nguyen (Quality/Safety), Jordan Hale (Validation). Ahmed is consulted on demand.
